Worth a try
May 2026 • Solo
The food is highly unusual, not the stuff you see on every other menu in town. Ordered two dishes . The stir-fried waxy corn was delicious. The smoked meat and vegetable dish was unacceptable, very little meat and mostly fat. Waitress said she'd fix it, never did. Eventually the manager came by for a long friendly chat and took it off my bill. 5 stars for the manager and his great attitude. Not impressed by the service. Also very noisy.

Superb cooking from North of Vietnam
Aug 2024 • Family
We tried this restaurant opened in June 2024. Dishes were excellent and very original. You can try 🌽 but won't find any yellow color. It is savoured! I loved the northern beer called bia Ha Nhi. It is made from rice! We ordered hot pot and fish. Price is reasonable. You should visit the restaurant, decorations are marvelous like a fairy tale. So much original ideas. My best experience in Hanoi!
